_doc: Benchmark rules for Tools/compare_benchmarks.py. Performance: the PR may not be more than max_slowdown slower than its base, measured on the same runner. Gameplay: per-match numbers (both teams together) from full 90-minute AI-vs-AI matches; 'real' is roughly what a top-flight match produces (EPL-style averages), so the table also shows how far the game is from real football. A change fails if it moves a stat further from its real band than the base was, by more than 'tolerance'. Stats without a band only fail on the listed must-rules.
